The Cassia County Courthouse is a beautiful example of classical architecture, with its grand facade and elegant interior. One of the most notable features of the Cassia County Courthouse is its grand staircase, which leads up to the main entrance. The staircase is made of marble and is accented with beautiful brass handrails, making it a stunning focal point of the building. The courthouse also features a large courtroom, complete with a raised judge's bench, jury box, and witness stand, that is still used for trials and events to this day.
